errors.fingerprint: AAPT2: 'PNG chunk type 49444154 is too large' then 'Exit code 139' (segmentation fault)
errors.rootCause: A PNG that is cut off or has damaged data. The shipped static aapt2 crashes on it; with damaged pixel data it crashes without naming the file.
errors.repair: PngSanitizer: structure check of every PNG before 'aapt2 compile'; after a failure a thorough check (checksums, pixel data size). The damaged image is replaced by a valid PNG that keeps the readable rows, in the build's copy (or in a copy of the folder for imported and library resources). The user's image is not changed. Only drawable*/mipmap* folders are checked (res/raw is copied verbatim by AAPT2 and left alone). With checksum damage the rows below the damaged spot can be wrong, and the warning says so.

Min SDK 21+ unchanged. v1.8.4: the project's own DEX output is now several files (R classes of the libraries pass 64K fields) and the activities and Application were in the last one; DexOrder merges the files that hold code first, R-only files after.

errors.fingerprint: DEX merge: java.nio.BufferOverflowException at DexMerger.transformDebugInfoItem
errors.rootCause: DexMerger reserved 2x the input's debug info; a 1-byte string/type index becomes 3 bytes when the merged DEX has 16384+ strings. Seen when the project's small DEX was merged into classes.dex with the libraries (min SDK < 21). v1.8.4: 3x the section was still not enough with the v1.8.4 libraries (fixture 907): D8 shares identical debug_info_items between methods, the merger writes one per code item.
errors.repair: v1.8.3: 3x + 8 bytes of the debug info section. v1.8.4: 3x the bytes written per code item (shared items counted per use) + 8, an upper bound while the merged dex has fewer than 2^21 strings.
verifiedOn: Android 12 ART (API 31) x86_64 harness, fixture 907 (v1.8.3 and v1.8.4)
JVM 17 replay of Dp.dexLibraries (copied verbatim) on fixture 907's inputs: the v1.8.3 merger overflows, the v1.8.4 merger merges

errors.fingerprint: Export AAB: Play Console may refuse the bundle as unsigned ("The Android App Bundle was not signed"); jarsigner (JDK 17): "treated as unsigned, because it is signed with a weak algorithm"

SHA-1 JAR signatures are disabled in current JDKs; a public report (B4X forum) shows Play rejecting an AAB with SHA-1 digests and accepting it with SHA-256.
errors.repair: v1.8.5 (owner's go): AABs are signed by com.sketchware.ai.project.BundleSigner (apksig, JAR signature only, SHA-256-Digest + SHA256withRSA; test key from cacheDir/libs/testkey or the user's keystore). APK export (ReleaseSigner/ApkSigner) unchanged. v1.8.4 and earlier: SHA-1, as described.
verifiedOn: Android 12 ART harness: Export AAB of fixtures 908/909/910 with the test key; jarsigner -verify on JVM 17 shows SHA1 digests / SHA1withRSA
